correction.text: 21 Sep 2026Correction, 21 September 2026. The Platform pressure table included a sentence that described Palo Alto Networks and F5 as hyperscalers, for their acquisitions of Protect AI, and of CalypsoAI and SurePath AI. Neither Palo Alto Networks nor F5 is a hyperscaler, and all three targets are AI security companies, not cloud security companies. That sentence is withdrawn. Each of those three rows is dated to this approval and states only that the target was acquired by a platform vendor, with no claim about what happens to the product next. The row for Wiz, bought by Google, was correct as printed and is unchanged. Jesse Pike.Approved by Jesse Pike
